description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BurgerRobot" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/burger-robot">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BurgerRobot" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Robot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Robot" name="Robot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MenuOrBurger</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MenuSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareDrink</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_AskSideChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SideChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFries</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareWedges</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SideMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MenuJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BurgerMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareBurger</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_StatusTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveStatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_StatusUpdateGiven</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverByConveyor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderDelivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuOrBurger" name="Menu or just the burger?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MenuChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuSplit" name="Start menu preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MenuChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPrepareDrink</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSideAnswer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPrepareDrink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinkDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AskSideChoice" name="Ask fries or wedges and record answer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSideAnswer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSideChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSideChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriesChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WedgesChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriesChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriesDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WedgesChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WedgesDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Side prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriesDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WedgesDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SideDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuJoin" name="Menu complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SideDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MenuDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BurgerMerge" name="Burger ready to prepare">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MenuDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPrepareBurger</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPrepareBurger</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Event_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToStatusUpdate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_StatusUpdate">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToStatusUpdate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusUpdateDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdateGiven" name="Status update given">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusUpdateDone</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverByConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToChoice" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_MenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChosen" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gateway_MenuSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsMenu}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!wantsMenu}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrepareDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSideAnswer" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="UserTask_AskSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSideChoice" sourceRef="UserTask_AskSideChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesChosen" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${side == 'fries'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesChosen" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${side == 'wedges'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideDone" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuDone" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrepareBurger" sourceRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverByConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToStatusUpdate" sourceRef="Event_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusUpdateDone" sourceRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdateGiven"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDelivered" sourceRef="Task_DeliverByConveyor" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
